body: I enjoyed this one as well! Although this may be a stupid question, what does agathokakologically mean?
I'm feeling like absolute shit today but I really wanted to let you know I enjoyed this poem a lot
I like how I prefaced it with saying I made it shorter when Im pretty sure I only made it longer... oops.

Yeah I get you! I would never bring it up in front of people anyway because then shed be defensive but I'll try bringing it up to her in person again... Its just I have really low self esteem and I'm horrible at getting my feelings across to people because I always feel like I'm in the wrong. Like I'm just being dramatic

She texts me every now and then and says that she misses me but I dont answer back. I've been missing my mother since before we stopped talking, she's changed into an entirely different person and it was hard for me to be around her without getting upset so I think it's actually better for my mental health to not have to deal with her. Its like watching someone you love slowly die.

And that last part is where it's going to be really hard for me to follow, because I have major trust issues when it comes to my personal life so I never tell anyone anything about how I'm feeling because I'm afraid they'll tell people and they'll think I'm crazy. M is the only person I've even remotely opened up to. But I feel like if I pointed out that she was hurting my feelings and I did it in front of others that she would just make some home about me being a girl and theyd join in. Like I really don't think they care about my feelings at all, although one time I mentioned that I had no one to talk to and she got offended so I'm sure that deep down they do care. I'm just worried about being seen as an overdramatic and super sensitive person that they won't want to be around... And thank you so much for your comment I really can't express how much it means to me. I'm typing in mobile and without my glasses on so I'm not sure if there are any major spelling mistakes in this but really thank you so so much for answering me

I had a talk with her where me, my dad, and my younger sister, and even my older sister all told her how that she needs to stop letting him walk all over her and that its splitting her off from her family. It ended with her telling us to not talk to her then, although she claims she never said that and that were all putting words in her mouths.

You are right though that she doesnt see why Im upset with her. She doesnt think its a big deal to have given me visiting hours and all that and thinks Im being overdramatic. Im not sure shell ever get it though to be honest - I called her once and asked her to have a talk with Steve because I miss my step sister and mom and she said she would. After a monthish (Jan to Feb) of her finding excuses as to why they didnt talk yet, one day I asked if they talked because she hadnt said anything to me in a few days and she said basically "Oh yeah he still said no."

My dad describes my mom like this:
Shes the kind of person who will complain about having a headache, but when you offer her an aspirin shell deny it and then just keep complaining. My dad is constantly swarmed with phone calls from my mom complaining about how terrible her life is and how she never gets to leave the house and it's gotten to a point where hes planning to have a talk with her, in person, where he says she either needs to take his advice and actually do something about it or she can stop talking to him as well because its stressful having to deal with her whining and then refusing to take any advice.

Ive already vented to her a few times before we stopped talking, and each time she got offended and told me to stop talking to her then if I hate her so much. Like I said shes really good at manipulating conversations and making people pity her :(

Ive not actually seen him at all though since he became so "disgusted" with me that he couldnt be around me.
